prompt: A skalder (Skalder), a Star Wars canon creature. The skalder were a mammalian desert species of herbivorous quadrupeds native to the plains of the planet Florrum. They were not normally ridden by sentient beings, but were surprisingly fast if such a feat was managed. They made exceptional pack animals, even in toxic environments and so were exported by pirate bands for use offworld. RimWorld top-down pawn sprite, desert-world creature, painterly game-art style matching the existing RimWorld/Star Wars mod roster, clean silhouette, transparent background.
style_notes: RimWorld creature sprite, Star Wars desert bestiary, our own art (not the donor mod's).
